reasons: import fails before construction: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'tensordict'
the constructor needs env_cfg/obs_cfg/reward_cfg/command_cfg, produced by go2_train.get_cfgs() which is itself unimportable (it enforces rsl-rl-lib>=5.0.0)
step() returns (TensorDict observation, rew_buf, reset_buf, extras); there is no episode-return array and returns only accumulate in the env's own episode_sums/extras
auto-reset is internal (no per-episode seed argument), so policies cannot be scored on the same ordered episode seeds, and there is no episodes_per_policy row contract
there is no evaluate(pop_arrays, generation) entry point, so the trainer cannot drive it
required_for_adapter: rsl-rl-lib>=5.0.0 (the config source go2_train/hover_train enforces the version and imports rsl_rl)
a per-environment seedable reset wrapper (the internal reset takes no seed)
an episode-return boundary and an evaluate(pop_arrays, generation) implementation
